text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Whoa… What's this feeling?! It's like I'm a dandelion seed floating on the wind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… Goddesses! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Now that I know you're rooting for me, I promise I won't let you down!
